title: Account Balance Inquiry
description: Customers should be able to view their current account balance and recent transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can view current balance after successful authentication
Transaction history displays last 30 days of activity by default
Balance updates are reflected within 3 seconds of a completed transaction

title: Fund Transfer
description: Customers should be able to transfer funds between accounts securely.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can initiate transfer between own accounts or to external accounts
System requires OTP verification for transfers exceeding the daily limit
Transfer confirmation displays transaction reference number and expected settlement date

title: Deposit Processing
description: Customers should be able to deposit funds via multiple channels.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can initiate a deposit through mobile, ATM, or branch channels
System validates deposit amount and displays confirmation before processing
Deposited funds are available in the account within the stated processing time
